notes: Hashes and byte strings are lowercase hex. verify_exit is the exit code of cncreplay.py verify: 0 complete and every seal matches, 1 a seal or structural check fails, 2 not a CNCR file, 3 no END section and every seal present matches, 4 not verified: the file is not malformed but its seal_version, or the codec of INIT or FRMS, is unknown, so its seals are neither confirmed nor refuted. error_code is the code cncreplay.py reports for a malformed or unverified file.

computations.name: utf8_replacement
computations.description: A writer replaces each ill-formed UTF-8 sequence with one U+FFFD, following the Unicode maximal-subpart practice.

computations.name: chat_fingerprint
computations.description: Section 8: the first 16 bytes of SHA-256("chat-proof-1" || salt || u32 sender house || UTF-8 text).
